content:
I can't agree that an argument is airtight before seeing it. Even the most confident person can have overlooked something, made a logical error, or built on a faulty premise. 

I'd be happy to look at your argument when you're ready to share it! I'll evaluate it fairly and point out its strengths as well as any potential weaknesses I might notice.
